items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: Yeah, I think about Red Caillou and Sun Swan.

ctx.x: How about piano? Blues piano. Oh, I have a bunch of them. I have a bunch of them.

Well, I'm running out of the question. You don't remember the names of any of those blues piano players, huh? No. Do you remember the names of any of those guys that played blues? Yeah, I think about Red Caillou and Sun Swan. Big Adlery Robertson. There's so many of them. There's so many of them. Friday Forward. Yeah. Drop them down.

Oh, by the way, this Buddy Bartley, did he all... You see the one who always went up there or... No, I think he's a girl. Or any other people went up there too? I mean, except for the lady. The woman? Yeah. Any white guy went up there? No. I've been on the street with him. I mean, they could. But it finally... We had a brother back there. How about a dog? How about a dog? How about a dog? A dog? A dog?
